scope: Independent source review and independent rerun of implementation-author synthetic controls for automated evidence closure. No AWS action, model request, candidate program execution, or V2 scientific artifact inspection was required.
resolved_findings: Generated-execution control evidence now requires exact 31/31 counts, frozen control-source hash and byte identity to the committed control receipt.
Reported scientific evidence is a separate payload; positive_policy_evidence is explicit null rather than a truthy dictionary.
reviewed_acceptance_boundaries: Both version-specific artifact audits must explicitly complete and pass with zero failures, unchanged auditor source, exact assignment counts and matching result hashes.
Full static selection replay is required; skipped replay cannot satisfy readiness.
Original and extension source, result, reproduction and imported-original lineage remain distinct.
Reproduction requires exact statistical payload equality, including the registered 5000-draw bootstrap, with no new inference or candidate execution.
Both exact campaign hosts must have a supplied verified stopped-state receipt after model processing, and separate/combined cost estimates must reconcile within limits.

A bounded negative result can be ready for paper development. Readiness does not require, manufacture or certify favorable hypotheses, policy superiority, novelty, primary-Praxis investment or publication acceptance.
limitations: This is a review of the assessor implementation, not a claim that the actual experiment has already passed every readiness condition.
The shutdown receipt is coordinator evidence at its timestamp; the assessor does not independently contact AWS.
Exact frozen-implementation statistical reproduction, independent arithmetic checking and population validity remain separate.
